name: nocodb
description: DEPRECATED — superseded by nocodb-dev (schema, fields, views, Meta API) and nocodb-ops (records, search, views, reports), which teach the current NocoDB MCP tool names; this plugin teaches tool names the server no longer exposes. NocoDB database development plugin. Manage tables, records, columns, views, relations, formulas, rollups, lookups, filtering, sorting, search, aggregation, webhooks, and filter/sort management via MCP tools.
